name: @mindstone/mcp-server-hubspot
description: HubSpot MCP server — CRM objects, associations, properties, marketing, files, workflows, and account diagnostics

scripts.build: tsc && shx chmod +x dist/index.js && bash scripts/check-no-bridge-strings.sh
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run test && bash scripts/check-no-bridge-strings.sh && npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high

_overridesRollbackNote.rationale: Transitive dependencies of @modelcontextprotocol/sdk had unpatched advisories at the time of pin (SDK 1.29.0). Overrides force-resolve to fixed versions; prepublishOnly's `npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high` gate fails-loud on regression.
_overridesRollbackNote.removalProcedure: When a new @modelcontextprotocol/sdk release resolves these transitively, remove the corresponding override entry and re-run `npm install && npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high`. Each override can be removed independently as upstream catches up.
_overridesRollbackNote.trackingUpstream: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/typescript-sdk — watch for SDK version that updates these dependencies
